custom_script.description: This script checks telemetry values from COSMOS and compares them against predicted values, reporting PASS if values match or FAIL if they do not.

input_field.name: start_time
input_field.description: The start time to query against (if none is provided the script will use the current time).

input_field.name: timeout
input_field.description: This, along with the start time, determines the time range to look for the telemetry value

input_field.name: lookback
input_field.description: A negative offset on the start time to use in the query.
The telemetry point name within the packet
input_field.name: tlm_point

input_field.description: The predicted/expected value for the telemetry point
input_field.name: predicted_value

input_field.description: Optional tolerance for numeric comparisons (absolute difference allowed)
input_field.name: tolerance

output_field.description: The actual telemetry value retrieved from COSMOS
output_field.name: actual_value

output_field.description: The timestamp when the telemetry value was retrieved
output_field.name: time_stamp
